verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a laptop processor, not a hosted service, so choosing a storage region or data residency is a category error for this kind of product. Mentions of AI running locally on the PC describe on-device compute, not a residency-selection feature, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
